name: Foil
author: E. T. Carter
description: A foil-stamped emblem pressed into dark card. A heavy ring, hairline inner ring, interlaced octagram and centre boss sit in the left third as brushed metal foil in a real debossed recess, lit rim on one side and wall shadow on the other, while a lamp off the upper right corner rakes across the fibre and laid lines of the stock and a slow looping light sweep crosses the sheet and makes the foil flash. The right two thirds stay even and quiet for a wordmark.

params.label: Light sweep
params.effect: How fast the lamp swings and the light sweep crosses the sheet; 0 freezes it and the foil holds one flash.

params.label: Deboss depth
params.effect: Depth of the stamp in CSS pixels: 0 is flat printed foil, high is a deep die impression with strong rim and wall shadow.

params.label: Mark size
params.effect: Radius of the emblem as a fraction of frame height, from a small seal to a mark that dominates the left half.

params.label: Foil shine
params.effect: Strength of the specular streak on the foil; low is brushed satin foil, high is mirror-bright.

params.label: Card grain
params.effect: Visibility of the fibre texture, tooth and laid lines in the card stock; 0 is smooth coated board.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer adds a second highlight on the foil; 0 ignores the mouse.
